name: Desert caravanserai
desc: a walled waystation on a trade road, where strangers share a fire for one night
tags: desert caravanserai, mud brick walls, arcaded courtyard, striped awnings, tethered camels, stacked bales and packs, stone water trough, palm trees above the wall, sand drifted against the brick, dust in the air
prose: a desert caravanserai built of mud brick, an arcaded courtyard hung with striped awnings, camels tethered beside stacked bales and packs, a stone water trough and palms showing above the wall, with sand drifted at the foot of the brick
note: Collapses into a generic crowded bazaar. Keep it a waystation: the camels, the stacked packs and the water trough are the difference between an inn and a market. Mud brick must be named explicitly or the walls render as carved palace stone, which moves it to the wrong class of building entirely.
